SAM material 4,4,4-NA (0.5 mg/mL) was added to influence crystal growth at the interface and optimize surface passivation. To enhance device performance, MACl (15.0 mg/mL) and m-Br-PEACl (2.0 mg/mL) were added to the perovskite solution as additives. For the perovskite films, the spin-coated process was divided by a consecutive two-step process, the spin rate of the first step is 1000 rpm for 5 s, and the spin rate of the second step is 5500 rpm for 30 s. At the 15 s of spinning, 150 µL of anti-solvent CB was dripped at the center. Subsequently, the sample was annealed at 110 °C for 15 min. The passivation solution was prepared using PDADI (0.5 mg/mL). Spin-coating of the passivation layer was performed at 5000 rpm for 30 s. During the spin-coating of the passivation layer, 70 µL of passivator was added at 6 s. The passivation layer was then annealed at 100 °C for 5 min to enhance film quality. In details, SAM solution was spin-coated on the substrate at 3000 rpm for 30 s, and annealed at 100 °C for 10 min..
